audit lens.cite: independent gate reviewer and sign-off two further fresh Claude contexts
audit lens.reply_head:
No
The audit lens requires git-only verifiability and zero loopholes. This proposal delegates critical verification to external AI contexts and manual gate checks that leave no immutable trace in git history. The cold reader and independent gate reviewer operate outside the repository, making it impossible to verify from git alone that they actually performed the review or that their conclusions were independent. This creates a loophole: the team could commit the green changes, skip or fabricate the external reviews, and still pass the dotnet test gate while breaking the independent review practice.
